metadata.name: CardActivationRequest
metadata.description: This API is used to activate a card with the help of activation Parameter.

request_fields.name: Source
request_fields.description: Source of API Consumer For external system expected sources will be WEB. Allowable Values: 50

request_fields.name: IPAddress
request_fields.description: IP Address of Client / Application Hosting Server Example: 10.206.0.204 Allowable Values: 15

request_fields.name: DateFormat
request_fields.description: Place Holder for Future Use. Values are: 1 : MM/dd/yyyy HH:MM:SS (Default) 2 : MM/dd/yy HH:MM:SS 3 : dd/MM/yyyy HH:MM:SS Allowable Values: 25

request_fields.name: CurrencyCode
request_fields.description: Currency Code Place Holder for Future Use. Valid Values: Refer Appendix Section - Currency Code Example:840 = US Dollar Condition:If no value is passed, default value = 840 Allowable Values: 10

request_fields.name: CurrencySymbolType
request_fields.description: Place Holder for Future Use. CurrencySymbolType: 1: Currency Sign like $ 2: 3 ALPHA Currency Code like USD Allowable Values: 10

request_fields.name: Language
request_fields.description: Place Holder for Future Use. Language: en: means use English Default: en - English Allowable Values: 10

request_fields.name: ExternalIP
request_fields.description: IP Address of end user of API Allowable Values: 50

request_fields.name: SessionID
request_fields.description: Session identifier of the API Example: 000028;026;1349906692 Allowable Values: 100

request_fields.name: APIVersion
request_fields.description: Version of the API to be invoked. Example: 2.0 API Version Current Version 2.0 Allowable Values: 10

request_fields.name: CallerID
request_fields.description: Caller ID of source from where API is initiated it is End User Caller ID Example: 7204454214 (phone number applicable in Case of IVR) Allowable Values: 20

request_fields.name: CalledID
request_fields.description: Called ID of destination for which API is initiated It is Destination Called ID Example: 7314145404 (phone number applicable in Case of IVR) Allowable Values: 20

request_fields.name: RequestTime
request_fields.description: Request Date Time of API Format: MM/dd/yyyy HH:mm:ss Example:01/15/2020 10:05:23

request_fields.name: CardNumber
request_fields.description: Card Number of account holder. Valid Values: 0-9 Format:XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX Example:1236547896325874 Condition:At least one of CardNumber/AdminNumber is required. Allowable Values: 19

request_fields.name: AdminNumber
request_fields.description: Details can be obtained by admin number (Embossing Acctid). Valid Values:0-9 Example:7485122 Condition:At least one of CardNumber/AdminNumber is required.

request_fields.name: CardType
request_fields.description: Type of the card as Visa, Master etc. Valid Values: 0 - MASTER 1 - DISCOVER 2 - STAR 3 - OTHER 4 - VISA 6 - AMEX Example: 4 - VISA

request_fields.name: FirstName
request_fields.description: Card Holder's First Name. Valid Values:A-Z Example:John Condition : Required when Card Activation Validation Parameters on Product include First Name. Allowable Values: 50

request_fields.name: MiddleName
request_fields.description: Card Holder's Middle Name. Valid Values: A-Z Example: LEE Condition : Required when Card Activation Validation Parameters on Product include Middle Name. Allowable Values: 50

request_fields.name: LastName
request_fields.description: Card holder's Last Name. Valid Values: A-Z Example: Smith Condition : Required when Card Activation Validation Parameters on Product include Last Name. Allowable Values: 50

request_fields.name: AddressLine1
request_fields.description: Card Holder's Address Line 1. Valid Values:A-Z, 0-9 Example:123 HWY Condition : Required when Card Activation Validation Parameters on Product include AddressLine1. Allowable Values: 50

request_fields.name: AddressLine2
request_fields.description: Card Holder's Address Line 2. Valid Values:A-Z, 0-9 Example:Park Avenue Condition : Required when Card Activation Validation Parameters on Product include AddressLine2. Allowable Values: 50

request_fields.name: EmailID
request_fields.description: Card Holder's Email Address. Valid Values: [email protected] Format: [email protected] Example: [email protected] Condition : Required when Card Activation Validation Parameters on Product include EmailID. Allowable Values: 100

request_fields.name: HomePhoneNumber
request_fields.description: Card Holder's Home Phone number. Valid Values:0-9 Example:7895463214 Condition : Required when Card Activation Validation Parameters on Product include Home Phone Number. Allowable Values: 20

request_fields.name: WorkPhoneNumber
request_fields.description: Card Holder's Work Phone number. Valid Values:0-9 Example:5678909876 Condition : Required when Card Activation Validation Parameters on Product include Work Phone Number. Allowable Values: 20

request_fields.name: PostalCode
request_fields.description: Postal Code of the Card Holder's Address. Valid Values:0-9 Example:46206 Condition : Required when Card Activation Validation Parameters on Product include Postal Code. Allowable Values: 10

request_fields.name: DateOfBirth
request_fields.description: Card Holder's Date of Birth. Valid Values:01/12/1990 Format: MM/dd/yyyy Example:07/25/1991 Condition : Required when Card Activation Validation Parameters on Product include DateOfBirth.

request_fields.name: LanguageIndicator
request_fields.description: Language Indicator. Valid Values:en,es Example:es Condition : Required when Card Activation Validation Parameters on Product include LanguageIndicator. Allowable Values: 5

request_fields.name: SocialSecurityNumber
request_fields.description: Social Security Number. Valid Values:0-9 Example: 678051120 Condition : Required when Card Activation Validation Parameters on Product include SocialSecurityNumber. Allowable Values: 9

request_fields.name: CardExpirationDate
request_fields.description: Card Expiration Date of requested card. Valid Values:0-9 Format:MMYYYY Example: 012020 Condition : Required when Card Activation Validation Parameters on Product include CardExpirationDate. Allowable Values: 8

request_fields.name: SSNLast4Digits
request_fields.description: Card Holder's last four digit of SSN. Valid Values:0-9 Example:1120 Condition : Required when Card Activation Validation Parameters on Product include SSNLast4Digits. Allowable Values: 4

request_fields.name: ActivationCode
request_fields.description: Code which is provided at the time of Account Creation/Registration should be pass as a user validation for card. Valid Values:0-9 Example:1120 Condition : Required when Card Activation Validation Parameters include Activation Code. Allowable Values: 50

request_fields.name: IdentifierToken
request_fields.description: A generated token that is not expired can be used as an input field to access API. If we are passing this field in input, user should not pass any other account identifier. Condition:At least one account identifier is required. Allowable Values: 800

request_fields.name: PIN
request_fields.description: Current PIN of the newly embossed card. Example:1234 Condition:Required when Card Activation Validation Parameters on Product include PIN.

request_fields.name: CVC2
request_fields.description: CVC2 number of the card generated. Example:123 Condition:Required when Card Activation Validation Parameters on Product include CVC.

request_fields.name: EmployeeID
request_fields.description: Card Holder's EmployeeID Example:123 Condition:Required when Card Activation Validation Parameters on Product include EmployeeID. Allowable Values: 25

request_fields.name: Last4ID
request_fields.description: Last 4 characters of ID except SSN. Valid Values:0-9, a-z, A-Z. Example:2234, 2ze8, AbcD. Allowable Values: 4

request_fields.name: IDtype
request_fields.description: ID type. Valid Values: 02 - Drivers license # 03 - Matricular Consular Number 04 - Passport 05 - Visa 06 - Green Card 07 - State ID 08 - Military ID 09 - Voters Registration Card 10 - Government ID 11 - Tax Identification Number Example: 01,11,02. Allowable Values: 2

request_fields.name: CardActivationviaTap
request_fields.description: This tag determines whether the card was activated by the customer tapping it on an NFC-enabled phone to confirm possession or not. Client needs to provide Yes/No basis the Activation method used by Customer. Valid Values: 0 - No 1 - Yes Example: 1

response_fields.name: Status
response_fields.description: API Status Example: Success - true, Error - false

response_fields.name: ErrorCode
response_fields.description: Response Message Error Code Allowable Values: 10
